analysis_method: Claude visual inspection of the full image

structural_characteristics.layout: Ten numbered sections stacked strictly vertically, each a wide card joined by short vertical connectors.
patterns: circled number pills centred on section tops
five-column stage cards with color-coded headers
convergent routing diagram (many inputs → process → CRM)
structural_characteristics.containment: Each section a tinted rounded card.

design_characteristics.background: White with soft colored glows behind sections.
design_characteristics.color_treatment: Per-section pastel gradient glows; colored stage headers.
design_characteristics.typography: Bold title with brand-colored word; small labels.
design_characteristics.containers: Rounded white cards on tinted section panels.
design_characteristics.connectors: Short vertical lines between sections; bracket-style convergence lines in routing section.

content_capacity.observed: Wide sections hold grids comfortably, but text is small at native width.

limitations: Strict vertical stack gives no natural hub position for the CRM step.
Very tall aspect; 102 nodes would push height further.

evidence.observation: Five stage columns with color-coded numbered headers and a cold-to-warm bar.
Six inputs converge via brackets into one process, then into CRM.

content_isolation: Reference text, names, logos, claims and creator branding are not carried into this run; only layout/design patterns are profiled.
